text:
Sam (release-manager): Heads-up — we discovered a perf regression in the v3.5 canary (p95 latency +35% on embedding path). I am instituting a 2-hour soft freeze from 12:00–14:00 UTC to let infra stabilize and run a rollback if needed. Please hold non-critical mergers and avoid new canary deployments.
Alex: Ack. Which service is the hotspot?
Sam (release-manager): realtime-embed and kv-cache proxy. Canary shows increased tail due to a new attention kernel change. We rolled a partial rollback to config v2026.03 for 2 nodes.
Priya: FYI @Jordan (oncall) — are we seeing error rates or just latency?
Jordan (oncall): Only latency so far, error rate 0.1% (normal). No customer-facing 5xx. Some requests triggered model fallback to v3.4 which kept responses correct.
Marta: Can we preemptively throttle batched requests to reduce the tail while debugging?
Sam (release-manager): Yes, please set the per-route concurrency to 8 for embeddings on canary nodes. Priya, can you push that?
Priya: On it. Will do via the rollout API: 
```
# throttle embeddings route on canary
curl -X POST https://api.internal.redwood/v1/rollout/config \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN' \
  -d '{"route":"/v1/embeddings","concurrency":8,"targets":["canary"]}'
```
Priya: Done — changed at 12:05 UTC.
OpsBot: Scheduled action: rollback realtime-embed canary group -> previous stable at 12:15 UTC. (triggered by Sam)
Alex: Do we need to update the release notes / changelog for this?
Sam (release-manager): Yes — add an interim note under "Rolling changes" and mark the v3.5 rollout as "paused — under investigation". I'll push a short blurb.
Marta: Any guidance for oncall? Should we escalate to infra if we see p95 > 2s?
Jordan (oncall): Escalation threshold: p95 embeddings > 2s for 5 consecutive mins. If hit, trigger rollback and notify infra pager.
Alex: Are we blocking customer launches?
Sam (release-manager): No block for customers on stable (hosted) — only internal canary traffic paused. If you have partner launches targeting v3.5, hold them and ping me.
Priya: OpsBot confirmed rollback executed at 12:15 UTC, canary group back to stable. Early metrics show p95 dropping ~28% after rollback.
Jordan (oncall): Monitoring dashboard link: https://dash.internal.redwood/boards/embed-p95 (watching).
Marta: I'll rerun the perf harness against the rolled-back canary and post results by 13:00 UTC.
Sam (release-manager): Thanks. Plan: 12:15 rollback (done), 12:30 verify metrics, 12:45 decide: resume canary with kernel tweak or freeze rollout. I will update by 13:00 UTC.
Alex: Appreciated — shout if you need a quick hotfix deploy.
Sam (release-manager): Quick update at 12:55 UTC: metrics look stable, p95 back to baseline. We're keeping the soft freeze until 14:00 UTC; no further canary pushes without approval. I'll post a final lift notice once I sign off. :white_check_mark:
Priya: Noted. Posting a short blurb to #product to avoid surprise.
Jordan (oncall): I'll keep an eye on error budget and ping infra if trend returns.
OpsBot: Note: release embargo active until 14:00 UTC.
Sam (release-manager): Final: embargo lifted at 13:35 UTC. We will not resume v3.5 canary until the kernel patch lands and we run a controlled small-batch canary. Closing thread — thanks all. :raised_hands:
